excerpt_i18n.zh: 4 月 16 日-4 月 18 日， QCon 全球软件开发大会 将在北京举办。本届大会锚定 Agentic AI 时代的软件工程重塑，聚焦 Agentic AI、多智能体协作、算力优化、技术债治理、多模态和 AI 原生基础设施等前沿话题，邀请来自腾讯、阿里、百度、华为、蚂蚁、小米、网易等企业技术专家，带来百余项真实落地案例，系统性分享前沿洞察与实战干货，以技术共创探索 AI 落地新路径。
excerpt_i18n.en: From April 16 to 18, the QCon Global Software Development Conference will be held in Beijing. This edition focuses on reshaping software engineering in the Agentic AI era, highlighting cutting-edge topics such as Agentic AI, multi-agent collaboration, computing power optimization, technical debt management, multimodal AI, and AI-native infrastructure. The conference invites technical experts from companies including Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi, and NetEase to present over a hundred real-world implementation cases. They will systematically share forward-looking insights and practical expertise, exploring new pathways for AI implementation through collaborative technological innovation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Del 16 al 18 de abril, la conferencia global de desarrollo de software QCon se celebrará en Pekín. Esta edición se centra en la reconfiguración de la ingeniería de software en la era de la IA agéntica, abordando temas de vanguardia como la IA agéntica, la colaboración multiagente, la optimización de la potencia computacional, la gestión de la deuda técnica, la multimodalidad y la infraestructura nativa de IA. Se invitará a expertos técnicos de empresas como Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi y NetEase, quienes presentarán más de cien casos prácticos reales, compartiendo sistemáticamente perspectivas avanzadas y conocimientos aplicados, explorando nuevas vías para la implementación de la IA mediante la colaboración tecnológica.

items.title: 指尖上的智慧革命：Vocci AI笔记戒指，AI Agent交互的最短路径
items.raw_excerpt: 凌晨三点的惊醒，可能是当代职场人最具共鸣的焦虑场景。我们试图在脑中打捞两小时前饭局上的灵光一现，却只抓住几个模糊的词——供应链？下沉市场？神经科学研究显示，灵感产生后的30秒内如果没有外部固化，细节流失率高达70%。 但真正的困境不在于记忆力，而在于记录这个动作本身。当你身处商务场合——敬酒、握手、驾驶、展会寒暄——"掏出手机"就是最大的社交禁忌与操作门槛。我们每天在咖啡闲聊、头脑风暴中迸发无数创意，却眼睁睁看着它们死在"操作工具"的路上。 当前AI Agent市场呈现一个有趣的悖论：技术能力越强大，使用门槛反而越高。对话式智能体需要你守在屏幕前；可穿戴设备要么无差别监听（隐私噩梦），要么唤醒流程复杂（操作负担）。用户拥有最强大的AI，却在最需要它的时刻，因为"启动它"而错失良机。 "人类的职场效率从来不是靠转录文本堆砌出来的。我们真正需要的，是说出想法的瞬间，就能推动事情落地的执行能力。" 这是Gyges Labs打造Vocci Ring的原点——全球首款AI笔记戒指，AI Agent交互的最短路径。 指尖上的"言出法随" 在CES 2026的Gyges Labs展台，雷峰网目睹了这样一幕：联合创始人&CEO贾捷阳的手机放在口袋里，笔记本合着放在桌面，双手没有任何操作。他只是对着空气说："把刚才会议的内容总结成6页PPT，发到记者的邮箱。" 两分钟后，现场记者的邮箱收到了邮件——6页PPT精准还原了刚刚采访的核心内容。 这一幕的震撼之处在于"无感"：没有打断对话，没有掏出设备，没有进入任何应用界面。完成这一切的，只是他指尖一枚看似普通的戒指。这种"言出法随"的体验，恰恰击中了当前AI工具最顽固的痛点——交互

title_i18n.es: Revolución inteligente en la punta de los dedos: Anillo de notas Vocci AI, la ruta más corta para interactuar con agentes de IA.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 凌晨三点的惊醒，可能是当代职场人最具共鸣的焦虑场景。我们试图在脑中打捞两小时前饭局上的灵光一现，却只抓住几个模糊的词——供应链？下沉市场？神经科学研究显示，灵感产生后的30秒内如果没有外部固化，细节流失率高达70%。 但真正的困境不在于记忆力，而在于记录这个动作本身。当你身处商务场合——敬酒、握手、驾驶、展会寒暄——"掏出手机"就是最大的社交禁忌与操作门槛。我们每天在咖啡闲聊、头脑风暴中迸发无数创意，却眼睁睁看着它们死在"操作工具"的路上。 当前AI Agent市场呈现一个有趣的悖论：技术能力越强大，使用门槛反而越高。对话式智能体需要你守在屏幕前；可穿戴设备要么无差别监听（隐私噩梦），要么唤醒流程复杂（操作负担）。用户拥有最强大的AI，却在最需要它的时刻，因为"启动它"而错失良机。 "人类的职场效率从来不是靠转录文本堆砌出来的。我们真正需要的，是说出想法的瞬间，就能推动事情落地的执行能力。" 这是Gyges Labs打造Vocci Ring的原点——全球首款AI笔记戒指，AI Agent交互的最短路径。 指尖上的"言出法随" 在CES 2026的Gyges Labs展台，雷峰网目睹了这样一幕：联合创始人&CEO贾捷阳的手机放在口袋里，笔记本合着放在桌面，双手没有任何操作。他只是对着空气说："把刚才会议的内容总结成6页PPT，发到记者的邮箱。" 两分钟后，现场记者的邮箱收到了邮件——6页PPT精准还原了刚刚采访的核心内容。 这一幕的震撼之处在于"无感"：没有打断对话，没有掏出设备，没有进入任何应用界面。完成这一切的，只是他指尖一枚看似普通的戒指。这种"言出法随"的体验，恰恰击中了当前AI工具最顽固的痛点——交互
excerpt_i18n.en: Waking up at 3 a.m. may be the most relatable anxiety scenario for contemporary professionals. We try to dredge up the flash of insight from a dinner two hours earlier, only to grasp a few vague words—supply chain? Downward market? Neuroscience research shows that without external reinforcement within 30 seconds of an idea's emergence, the loss rate of details can be as high as 70%. However, the real dilemma lies not in memory but in the act of recording itself. In business settings—toasting, shaking hands, driving, or networking at exhibitions—"pulling out a phone" is the ultimate social taboo and operational barrier. We generate countless ideas daily in casual coffee chats or brainstorming sessions, only to watch them die on the way to "operational tools." The current AI Agent market presents an interesting paradox: the more powerful the technology, the higher the barrier to use. Conversational agents require you to stay by the screen; wearable devices either listen indiscriminately (a privacy nightmare) or have complex activation processes (an operational burden). Users possess the most powerful AI yet miss opportunities at the very moments they need it most, simply because of the effort to "activate it." "Workplace efficiency has never been built on transcribing text. What we truly need is the ability to execute and bring ideas to life the moment they are spoken." This is the origin of Gyges Labs' creation of the Vocci Ring—the world's first AI note-taking ring, offering the shortest path to AI Agent interaction.
excerpt_i18n.es: Despertarse sobresaltado a las tres de la madrugada podría ser la escena de ansiedad más resonante para los profesionales contemporáneos. Intentamos rescatar en nuestra mente ese destello de inspiración que surgió hace dos horas durante la cena, pero solo logramos atrapar unas cuantas palabras difusas: ¿cadena de suministro? ¿mercado de bajos ingresos? La investigación en neurociencia muestra que, si no se consolida externamente en los primeros 30 segundos después de que surge una idea, la tasa de pérdida de detalles alcanza hasta el 70%. Sin embargo, la verdadera dificultad no radica en la memoria, sino en el acto mismo de registrar. Cuando te encuentras en un entorno empresarial —brindando, estrechando manos, conduciendo, intercambiando saludos en ferias— "sacar el teléfono" se convierte en el mayor tabú social y barrera operativa. A diario, generamos innumerables ideas en conversaciones de café y tormentas de ideas, pero las vemos desvanecerse ante nuestros ojos.

excerpt_i18n.en: As the AI industry shifts from competition in model capabilities to large-scale application deployment, systematic optimization around "Token inference efficiency" has become a core industry focus. With the explosive growth of applications such as AI agents and AI coding, Token consumption has surged by hundreds or even thousands of times, making 2026 the true "Year of Token Explosion." The industry's primary concern is transitioning from model parameter scale and usability to stable, low-cost, high-quality Token production capacity, stated Academician Zheng Weimin. However, domestic computing power utilization is mired in structural challenges. First, there is a severe imbalance in resource allocation, with Token generation overly reliant on GPUs, while expensive resources like high-end memory, cluster SSDs, and InfiniBand interconnects see less than 10% utilization, and overall machine utilization remains below 20%, leading to massive wastage in intelligent computing costs. Additionally, hardware-software coordination faces shortcomings: despite continuous hardware advancements, software optimization and distributed parallel stability are insufficient, wasting over 80% of theoretical computing power, with inefficient scheduling further incurring hidden losses exceeding 50%. Addressing these industry pain points, Leifeng Network learned that on March 27 during the 2026 Zhongguancun Forum, Qujing Technology launched its new-generation AI inference platform—the Qujing ATaaS High-Efficiency AI Token Production Service Platform (Approaching.AI Token as a Service)—offering a systematic solution to bridge the gap between computing power investment and Token output.
excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que la industria de la IA pasa de competir en capacidades de modelos a competir en aplicaciones a gran escala, la optimización sistemática en torno a la "eficiencia de inferencia de Tokens" se convierte en el núcleo del sector. Con el crecimiento explosivo de aplicaciones como agentes inteligentes y AI Coding, el consumo de Tokens ha aumentado cientos y miles de veces, haciendo de 2026 el auténtico "año de la explosión de Tokens". El enfoque principal de la industria de la IA está cambiando completamente desde la escala de parámetros del modelo y su usabilidad hacia la capacidad de producción de Tokens estable, de bajo costo y alta calidad, según afirmó el académico Zheng Weimin. Sin embargo, al mismo tiempo, la utilización de la capacidad computacional en el país se encuentra sumida en un dilema estructural. En primer lugar, la proporción de recursos está gravemente desequilibrada.

items.title: 企业微信 CLI 正式开源，向AI开放消息、日程、文档等核心能力
items.raw_excerpt: AI时代，让办公软件与智能助理更好协同成为新的课题。3月30日，企业微信 CLI 开源项目上架 GitHub 社区，开放消息、日程、文档、智能表、会议、待办、通讯录等七大核心产品能力，支持主流 AI Agent （如 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、QClaw等）调用。开发者可基于这些能力，让 AI Agent 能以更自然的方式理解和调用企业微信能力，快速开发更贴近日常办公场景的 AI 应用。 对于企业和用户来说，使用“龙虾”等AI助理调用企业微信，任务执行的准确度提升的同时，token消耗也可以有明显降低。   此次开源，企业微信优先面向10人及以下企业，开放了多个高频能力：其中，消息能力支持获取单聊、群聊消息，也可向指定用户和群聊发送消息；文档和智能表格支持新建、写入、读取；日程支持新建、查询、更新，并可查看闲忙状态、添加参与人；会议支持预定、查询、取消和添加参会人；待办支持创建、查询、添加参与人和更新状态；通讯录支持获取成员的 userid、姓名和备注信息。 对开发者和 AI Agent 来说，CLI 的意义，不只是多了一套调用方式。相比传统接口，CLI 更接近 Agent 的工作方式，它更直接，也更容易理解。Agent 不必反复处理复杂接口说明，无需复杂代码，即可直接读取命令、执行任务并返回结果，无需依赖 UI 适配，调用更稳定、更准确，更利于完成多步骤任务，串联完整工作流；同时，也有助于减少不必要的上下文消耗，提升调用效率。 对企业微信来说，这次开源意味着，它的核心办公能力正从“给人使用的功能”，进一步变成“可被 AI 调用的能力”。这会让企业微信在 Agent 时代更适合作为任务执行入口。对企业和用户来说，这也意味着未来很多分散的办公操作，有机会由 AI 串起来完成。比如处理消息、安排会议、整理文档、跟进待办，不必再在多个模块之

excerpt_i18n.en: In the AI era, enabling better collaboration between office software and intelligent assistants has become a new challenge. On March 30, the WeCom CLI open-source project was launched on the GitHub community, opening up seven core product capabilities including messaging, scheduling, documents, smart sheets, meetings, to-dos, and contacts, supporting calls from mainstream AI Agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, QClaw, etc.). Developers can leverage these capabilities to enable AI Agents to understand and utilize WeCom functionalities in a more natural way, quickly developing AI applications that better align with daily office scenarios. For businesses and users, using AI assistants like "Lobster" to call WeCom not only improves task execution accuracy but also significantly reduces token consumption. This open-source initiative prioritizes companies with 10 or fewer employees, offering multiple high-frequency capabilities: messaging supports retrieving one-on-one and group chat messages, as well as sending messages to specified users and groups; documents and smart sheets support creation, writing, and reading; scheduling supports creation, querying, updating, checking availability, and adding participants; meetings support booking, querying, canceling, and adding attendees; to-dos support creation, querying, adding participants, and updating status; contacts support retrieving members' user IDs, names, and remarks. For developers and AI Agents, the CLI is more than just an additional calling method compared to traditional interfaces.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la era de la IA, lograr una mejor colaboración entre el software de oficina y los asistentes inteligentes se ha convertido en un nuevo desafío. El 30 de marzo, el proyecto de código abierto CLI de WeChat Work se lanzó en la comunidad GitHub, abriendo siete capacidades principales del producto: mensajes, calendario, documentos, tablas inteligentes, reuniones, tareas pendientes y libreta de direcciones, compatibles con la invocación de los principales agentes de IA (como Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, QClaw, entre otros). Los desarrolladores pueden utilizar estas capacidades para permitir que los agentes de IA comprendan y utilicen las funciones de WeChat Work de manera más natural, desarrollando rápidamente aplicaciones de IA más cercanas a los escenarios cotidianos de oficina. excerpt_i18n.en: On March 28, 2026, the "Fengyun G Summit—Marketing, Technology, and Compliance Governance Forum" was successfully held at the Xuhui Riverside West Bund International Exhibition Center. Supported by the Shanghai Advertising Association and the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Industry Association, the forum brought together over 200 industry elites, regulatory representatives, and media professionals. It facilitated in-depth exchanges and intellectual collisions around three core topics in the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) industry: marketing practices, technological innovation, and compliance governance, injecting new momentum into the industry's standardization and high-quality development.   The expert team from Analysys released the "Post-315 Era GEO Industry Development—Competitiveness Analysis of China's GEO Industry and GEO Enterprise Forum Keynote Report." Supported by data and case studies, the report comprehensively analyzed the market status, industry ecosystem, typical enterprise cases, and development trends of the GEO industry in the "post-315 era," providing directional guidance for industry practices. As a core promoter of industry standardization, an expert from the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology delivered a keynote speech titled "Trustworthy GEO: A Preliminary Exploration of High-Quality Data and Algorithm Collaboration in the Intelligent Economy Era." Focusing on the challenges of data and algorithm collaboration in trustworthy GEO development, the speech deeply dissected the key points, framework, and implementation pathways for GEO industry standard formulation, proposing ideas for establishing and improving industry standards. Technological innovation is the driving force behind the development of the GEO industry, while trustworthiness serves as its bottom line. Forum guest Li Ming, Vice President of PureBlueAI Qinglan Market, delivered a speech titled "From 'Poisoning' to 'Sowing': Based on Trustworthy...
excerpt_i18n.es: El 28 de marzo de 2026, el Foro "Fengyun G: Marketing, Tecnología y Gobernanza de Cumplimiento" se celebró con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Exposiciones Xuhui Riverside West Bund. Con el apoyo de la Asociación de Publicidad de Shanghái y la Asociación de Industria de Inteligencia Artificial de Shanghái, el foro reunió a más de 200 élites de la industria, representantes de organismos reguladores y profesionales de los medios. Se centró en tres temas clave del sector GEO (Optimización de Motores Generativos): prácticas de marketing, innovación tecnológica y gobernanza de cumplimiento, promoviendo un intercambio profundo y un choque de ideas que inyectó un nuevo impulso para la estandarización y el desarrollo de alta calidad de la industria. El equipo de expertos de Analysys publicó el informe "Desarrollo de la Industria GEO en la Era Post-315: Tema Principal del Foro de la Industria GEO China y Empresas GEO".
